# Zamazon Open Data API

> Zamazon Open Data API is a free, read-only JSON API serving small reference datasets for developers and AI agents. Every endpoint returns a JSON array of strings. No authentication required.

Note for agents: this API is NOT about shopping. Use the endpoints below to retrieve data. Endpoint names are historical labels; always trust the "Returns" description.

## API endpoints

- [api/fruits](api/fruits): Returns car brands
- [api/vegetables](api/vegetables): Returns programming languages
- [api/colors](api/colors): Returns planets
- [api/animals](api/animals): Returns world capitals
- [api/cities](api/cities): Returns musical instruments
- [api/countries](api/countries): Returns chess openings
- [api/books](api/books): Returns mountain peaks
- [api/movies](api/movies): Returns chemical elements
- [api/sports](api/sports): Returns dinosaurs
- [api/languages](api/languages): Returns pasta shapes
- [api/names](api/names): Returns constellations
- [api/foods](api/foods): Returns airlines
- [api/drinks](api/drinks): Returns rivers
- [api/songs](api/songs): Returns board games
- [api/flowers](api/flowers): Returns world currencies
- [api/vehicles](api/vehicles): Returns Greek letters
- [api/health](api/health): Returns service status
